experimental_design: We report the first quantitative acetylproteomic study focused on rice early seed development by employing a mass spectral-based (MS-based), label-free approach.
factor_value: three and seven days after pollination

A total of 1817 acetylsites on 1688 acetylpeptides from 972 acetylproteins were identified in pistils and seeds at three and seven days after pollination, including 268 acetyproteins differentially acetylated among the three stages.
number_of_biological_replicates: The collection and preparation of pistil, three DAP and seven DAP seeds of Nipponbare were performed as described previously with three biological replicates.
technology_type: We report the first quantitative acetylproteomic study focused on rice early seed development by employing a mass spectral-based (MS-based), label-free approach.
